title: केकी जो बनावै तौ बनैयौ बनराज जू कौं - श्री लाल बलबीर, ब्रज बिनोद, राधा शतक (110)
sanskrit_text:
(कवित्त)
केकी जो बनावै तौ बनैयौ बनराज जू कौं,
कूक कूक नाच नाच सुजस सुनाऊँ मैं। [1]
लता द्रुम बेली रंगरेली जो करौ तौ करौ,
रावरे ही अंगन पै पुष्प-झर लाऊँ मैं॥ [2]
जो पै रज-रेनुका बनावौ मन भायौ ये ही,
तौ पै पद पंकजन सीस पै धराऊँ मैं। [3]
ये ही बर पाऊँ ललचाऊँ सुख साधे राधे,
बास दे निकुंजन को तेरौ ही कहाऊँ मैं॥ [4]
- श्री लाल बलबीर, ब्रज बिनोद, राधा शतक (110)
hindi_text:
श्री लाल बलबीर श्री राधारानी से कहते हैं, "यदि आप मुझे मयूर ही बनाना चाहें तो श्री वृंदावन धाम का ही बनाइए, जिससे मैं कूक कर और नाच कर आपका यश ही आपको सुनाऊँ।" [1]


यदि आप मुझे लता, द्रुम, या बेली बनाना चाहें, तो अपने आंगन का ही बनाइए, जहाँ नित्य लीला होती है, जिससे मैं आपको प्रसन्न करने के लिए आंगन में पुष्प बरसा सकूँ। [2]


यदि आपका मन भाए कि आप मुझे रज कण ही बनाना चाहें, तो भी आप अपने पद पंकज की ही रज बनाएँ, जिससे आपके चरण कमल नित्य ही मेरे शीश पर रहें। [3]


श्री लाल बलबीर कहते हैं, "मैं यही वर पाना चाहता हूँ कि मैं आपके सुख के लिए नित्य ही ललचाया करूँ, आप मुझे निकुंज में ही नित्य वास दें, चाहे किसी भी रूप में, और हे राधे, मैं केवल और केवल आपका ही कहलाऊँ।" [4]
english_text:
(Kavitt)
Keki Jo Banavai Tau Banaiyau Banraj Ju Kaun,
Kuk Kuk Nach Nach Sujas Sunaun Main. [1]
Lata Drum Beli Rangareli Jo Karau Tau Karau,
Ravare Hi Angan Pai Pushp-jhara Laun Main. [2]
Jo Pai Raj-renuka Banavau Man Bhayau Ye Hi,
To Pai Pad Pankajan Sis Pai Dharaun Main. [3]
Ye Hi Bar Paun Lalachaun Sukh Sadhe Radhe,
Baas De Nikujan Ko Terau Hi Kahaun Main. [4]
- Shri Lal Balbir, Braj Binod, Shri Radha Shatak (110)

Śrī Lal Balbir says to Śrī Rādhā, If you want to make me a peacock, kindly make me the peacock of Vṛndāvana, so that I can make you happy by dancing and singing your glories. [1]

If You wish to make me a creeper, tree, or vine, then let it be in Your own courtyard, where pastimes unfold continuously, so that I may shower flowers in the courtyard to please You. [2]

If you want to make me dust as per your pleasure, kindly make me the dust of Vṛndāvana so that I can always carry Your lotus feet upon my head. [3]

Śrī Lāl Balbir says, “This is the boon I desire: that I may eternally yearn for Your pleasure, that You may grant me perpetual residence in the Nikunj in any form, and O Rādhey, may I be called solely and entirely Yours.” [4]

title: ह्म लोक पर्यंत सुख - जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज, भक्ति शतक (45)
sanskrit_text:
ब्रह्म लोक पर्यंत सुख, अरु मुक्तिहुँ सुख त्याग।
तबै धरहु पग प्रेम पथ, नहिं लगि जैहैं दाग॥
- जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज, भक्ति शतक (45)
hindi_text: ब्रह्मलोक पर्यन्त के सुखों की कामना तथा पाँचों मुक्तियों की अभिलाषा का त्याग करके ही विशुद्ध भक्ति-सरिता में अवगाहन करना चाहिए; अन्यथा प्रेम के उज्ज्वल स्वरूप पर कामनाओं का काला धब्बा लग जाएगा।
english_text:
Brahm lok paryant sukh, aru muktihun sukh tyag.
Tabai dharahu pag prem path, nahin lagi jaihain dag.
Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Bhakti Shatak (45)

Abandoning all desires for pleasures and luxuries up to Brahma's abode and the desire for the five kinds of liberation, immerse yourself in the ocean of bhakti. Otherwise, the purity of bhakti will be blemished by the stain of worldly desires.

author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Chitvat Chit Karshat Jite - Jagadguru Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Bhakti Shatak (54)
hindi_text: Chitvat Chit Karshat Jite, Chitt Samadhi Mahan Laay.Auran Ki Ka Baat Kaha, Shiv Gopi Tanu Paay.- Jagadguru Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Bhakti Shatak (54)With a single rasa-filled glance of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, even the greatest paramahaṁsas forget their deep states of samādhi — and what to speak of such realized souls, when even Lord Śiva Himself assumed the form of a gopī in order to taste that divine nectar.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Aandesh Ke Gaman Ko - Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vrindavan Shatak Pratham (34)
hindi_text: Aandesh Ke Gaman Ko, Matkar Vir Vichar.Pher Kahan Vrindavipin, Kahan Yah Jugal Bihar.- Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vrindavan Shatak Pratham (34)O brother, do not even in a dream contemplate the thought of going to any other place or land. Where else can one find such a supremely divine place as Śrī Vṛndāvana, where the divine Couple eternally perform Their nitya-vihāra? Therefore, never lose this most blessed fortune of residing in this holy land.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Radhike Kahe Karo Hath Ri - Shri Hati Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (65)
hindi_text: (Savaiya) Radhike Kahe Karo Hath Ri, Sunari Bar Bol Piyush Se Pi Ke. [1] Bhaunhain Chadhaya Kaha Satrai Ke, Nain Nachaya Bakai Gun Sike. [2] Sambhu Suresh Ganesh Na Pavat, Prem Ke Dore Bandhe Tub Hi Ke. [3] Mano Manayo Paraun Pare, Man Bhavan Mohan Bhavate Ji Ke. [4]- Shri Hati Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (65)O Rādhike, why do You hold on to this gentle sulk without reason? Please listen for a moment to the sweet, nectar-like words of Your beloved. [1]Why do You sit with raised brows in loving displeasure, glancing playfully and speaking such sharp words, as if learned from elsewhere? [2]Lord Kṛṣṇa, whom even Lord Śiva, Indra, and Gaṇeśa cannot easily attain, is bound solely by the rope of Your love. [3]Your beloved Manmohana, who pleases Your heart, lies in Your lotus-feet, trying to appease You. Therefore, O Kiśorī Jī, please be pleased now and accept His loving plea. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shri Vrishbhan Kishori Sujan - Sri Hita Parmanand Das Ji Ki Vani, Shri Radhashtak (01)
hindi_text: (Sawaiya)Shri Vrishbhan Kishori Sujaan, Sunau Vinati Sudhi Leu Hamari. [1]Aapni Jani Kripa Kariken, Hansi Heri Kahau Sakhi Aau Hamari. [2]Naam Kahun Gun Gai Rahun, Pad-Kanj Bina Gati Hai Na Hamari. [3]Paas Rahai Paramanand Shrihit, Radhika Jeevan Praan Hamari. [4]- Shri Hita Parmanand Das, Sri Hita Parmanand Das Ji Ki Vani, Shri Radhashtak (01)O ever-fresh, youthful Skillful Queen, Śrī Rādhā! Kindly hear my plea and think about this humble soul. [1]Considering me as Your maidservant, bestow such grace upon me that You glance toward me with a gentle smile and say, “O sakhī, come near to me.” [2]May I constantly call out Your holy Name and sing Your glories, for apart from Your lotus feet, I have no other shelter. [3]Śrī Hita Paramānanda Dāsa Jī says: this alone is my longing that I may always remain near You, serving you selflessly, for, O Śrī Rādhikā Jī, You alone are the very life and soul of my existence. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Indra-Mad-Mardan Durg - Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati, Vrindavan Shatak (5)
hindi_text: (Kavitta) Indra-Mad-Mardan Durg Giri Gobarddhan Hai, Amrit Saman Bahai Yamuna Ka Panee Hai. [1] Prem Ka Prakash Yahin Rasaka Vikas Hua, Jisaki Amar Ek Uttam Kahanee Hai. [2] Vraj-Nav-Yuvaraj Hain Rajya Karate Jahan, Radhika Saman Sarva Shreshth Maharanee Hai. [3] Preeti Kee Pataka Hai Udati Raj Mandir Pai, Vrindavan Prem Kee Pavitra Rajadhanee Hai. [4]- Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati ‘Hare Krishn’, Vrindavan Shatak (5)Girirāja Govardhana stands as the divine fortress that crushed the pride of Indra, while the sacred waters of Śrī Yamunā Jī flow there like nectar. [1]It is in this land that divine love manifested, and where the Mahārāsa took place — those eternal and supreme pastimes revered even today. [2]Here reigns Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the youthful prince of Braja, and here resides Śrī Rādhikā Mahārānī, the supreme Queen. [3]Upon the royal temple of this land, the banner of pure selfless love forever flutters — such is Śrī Vṛndāvana Dhāma, the sacred capital of divine love. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Yadaiva Sachchidrasarupa - Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (17.84)
hindi_text: Yadaiva Sachchidrasarupa Buddhivrrindavanasthasthirajamgameshu.Syannirvyalikam Purushastadaiva Chakasti Radhapriya Sevirupah.- Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (17.84)When one develops a pure realization of all beings — both moving and unmoving — within Śrī Vṛndāvana as embodiments of Sata-Chita-Rasa (eternal existence, pure consciousness, and divine rasa), only then does one attain the eligibility to become a beloved maidservant of Śrī Rādhā, fit for Her intimate service.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Lochan Syam Sudhir Ke - ShriBhatt Devacharya, Yugal Shatak (63)
hindi_text: Lochan Syam Sudhir Ke, Mochan Virah Visaal.Bin Hi Anjan Yeh Aho, Khanjan Lochan Baal.- Shri Bhatt Devacharya, Yugal Shatak (63)Śrī Raṅgadevī Jī says to Śrī Lalitā Jī: O Lalite! Behold the eyes of Śrī Rādhā — how they shine like the graceful khanjana birds. Although Śrī Rādhā has not adorned Her eyes with collyrium, even without it, these khanjana-like glances possess the power to dispel the pangs of separation from the heart of Vṛndāvana-Bihārī, Śrī Kṛṣṇa.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Makhan Ten Makhatulhu Te - Shri Hati Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (79)
hindi_text: (Sawaiya)Makhan Ten Makhatulhu Ten, Sukumar Siroman Kanj Kali Ke. [1]Lal Gulal Praval Ke Bhushan, Dushan Hain Ghanshyam Chhali Ke. [2]Aali Gulab Ko Aabahi Variye, Chariye Ye Brajkunj Thali Ke. [3]Bhanu Pratap Kau Nindit Hai, Pad Bandat Haun Vrishbhanlali Ke. [4]- Shri Hati Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (79)The lotus feet of Śrī Vṛṣabhānu’s daughter are softer than butter and finer than silk. They are more tender than the delicate buds of a lotus. [1]Those sacred feet are deep red like gulāla and coral gems, and so powerful in beauty that they subdue even the pride of the beauty of Śrī Kṛṣṇa. [2]O sakhī, even the radiance and charm of a rose deserve to be offered in surrender before those feet, for they wander gracefully through the kuñjas of Braja. [3]Before the brilliance of those feet, even the splendor of the sun appears pale and diminished. Śrī Haṭhī Jī declares that he bows down in honor to those very lotus feet of Śrī Rādhā Mahārāṇī Jū. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Desh Deshantar Ke Anek - Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati, Vrindavan Shatak (9)
hindi_text: (Kavitt)Desh Deshantar Ke Anek Vyakti Aate Yahan,Jinke Hriday Mein Jalti Prem-Jwala Hai. [1]Gopi Guru Gaurav Se Raj Rahe Kunjana Mein,Pakar Pravesh Hota Chit Matwala Hai. [2]Prem Ki Pariksha Hoti Prem Ka Hi Prashnapatra,Prem Ka Praman-Patra Milta Nirala Hai. [3]Uddhav Se Shishya Jahan Aaye Path Padhne Ko,Vrindavan Prem Ki Pavitra Pathshala Hai. [4]- Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati ‘Hare Krishn’, Vrindavan Shatak (9)From distant lands and regions, countless souls are irresistibly drawn here, their hearts ablaze with the burning flame of love. [1]Within these sacred kuñjas, the gopīs shine resplendent, established upon the exalted seat of the guru. The very moment a seeker gains entry here, the heart becomes intoxicated with the bliss of love. [2]Here, love alone is examined, and love itself forms the question. Upon passing, one receives a wondrous certificate of divine love. [3]It is none other than Śrī Vṛndāvana Dhāma — the supremely sacred academy of divine love — where even Uddhava, the most exalted among the wise, came as a humble student to learn the lesson of divine love. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Aaye Fag Khelan Gopal Barsane Mein - Shri Lal Balbir Ji, Braj Binod, Shadritu Shatak
hindi_text: (Kavitt)Aaye Faag Khelan Gopal Barsane Mein,Gaaven Khyaal De De Taal, Ur Harashat Hain. [1]Itte Kishori Gori Sakhin Ke Yooth Mahan,Lekar Abeer Pai Kapol Parasat Hain. [2]Kanchan Pichkari Taki Maarat Bihari Neer,‘Laal Balbir’ Ang Preet Darasat Hain. [3]Chhatan Ten Chhajjan Ten Jharokhan Ten Mokhan Ten,Aaj Nandalal Pai Gulaal Barasat Hain. [4]- Shri Lal Balbir Ji, Braj Binod, Shadritu ShatakŚrī Gopāla has arrived in Barsānā to celebrate the joyous festival of Phāga (Holī). All around, people sing the songs of Phāguna, clap their hands in rhythmic beat, and every heart sways in delight. [1]Meanwhile, the fair Kiśorī, Śrī Rādhā, stepping gracefully forward from amidst Her circle of sakhīs, takes abīra (scented powder) in Her hands and lovingly applies it upon the cheeks of Śyāmasundara. [2]On the other side, Bāṅke Bihārī raises His golden water-guns and showers streams of color. Śrī Lāla Balabīra says it appears as though from every limb of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the very hue of divine love itself is overflowing. [3]From rooftops, balconies, latticed windows, and from every side, every corner, people are joyfully raining gulāla upon Śrī Kṛṣṇa on this festive day. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Khanjan Mrig Saramay Ke - Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati ‘Hare Krishn’, Shyam Shatak (01)
hindi_text: Khanjan Mrig Saramay Ke, Vipin Basai Din Rain.Safari Sarasij Jal Chhipe, Dekhi Shyaam Ke Nain. - Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati ‘Hare Krishn’, Shyam Shatak (01)Upon beholding the playful, captivating eyes of Śyāmasundara, the wagtail birds and the deer were overcome with shame, choosing to dwell deep within the forest day and night. Likewise, the fish and the lotus blossoms sought refuge beneath the waters, hiding away after witnessing those beautiful eyes.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Ma Kurukarma Na Yogam - Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (7.09)
hindi_text: Ma Kurukarma Na Yogam Na Vishnubhajanam Na Va Shravanam‌.Dhruvamavapsyasi Parapadam Vrrindaranye Yatha Tatha Tishthan‌.- Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (7.09)Do not engage in pious deeds, do not practice yoga, do not worship Lord Viṣṇu, and do not listen to His glories. By merely residing in the sacred land of Vṛndāvana, you will surely attain the highest spiritual perfection.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Govardhane Krrita Yena Pritih Shri Harivallabhe - Shri Keshavachary, Govardhan Shatak (90)
hindi_text: Govardhane Krrita Yena Pritih Shri Harivallabhe.Manusham Janmamasadya Tena Sarvam Shubham Krritam.- Shri Keshavachary, Govardhan Shatak (90)One who, having attained a human birth, develops love for Śrī Girirāja Govardhana, the most beloved of Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa, accomplishes all auspicious deeds in this world; indeed, the birth of such a person alone is truly fulfilled.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Baithi Rang Bhari Hai Rangili - Shri Hati Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (18)
hindi_text: (Kavitt)Baithi Rang Bhari Hai Rangili Rang Ravati Mein,Kahan Lau Bakhanau, Sundarai Sirtaj Ki. [1]Chandani Ki, Champak Ki, Chanchala Chamikar Ki,Indma, Tilottama Ki Sobha Kaun Kaj Ki. [2]Motin Ke Har Garen, Motin Sau Maang Bharai,Motin Saun Beni Guhi Hathi Sukhsaj Ki. [3]Chal Gajraj, Mrigraj Ki-Si Lank Duj,Raaj-Sau Vadan, Rajai Rani Brajraj Ki. [4]- Shri Hati Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (18)Immersed in the colors of divine love, the playful Śrī Rādhā graces the pavilion of Raṅga Mahala with incomparable beauty. How can the limitless splendor of such a supreme crowned queen ever be contained within mere words? [1]The brilliance of moonlight, the tenderness of champak blossoms, the radiance of molten gold, and the combined beauty of celestial maidens Indumatī and Tilottama—all fade before even a single glimpse of Her divine form. [2]Beautiful pearl necklaces adorn her neck, her parting is decorated with pearls, and her braid is woven with pearls as well—her entire adornment overflows with unparalleled charm. [3]Her majestic gait sways like an intoxicated elephant king, Her slender waist moves with the elegant grace of a lioness, and Her radiant complexion glows with royal splendor. Thus, Śrī Rādhā, the Queen of Braj’s Lord, Śrī Kṛṣṇa is gracefully seated. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Bhrikuti Bank Garh Madhya Mein - Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati ‘Hare Krishn’, Shyam Shatak (07)
hindi_text: Bhrikuti Bank Garh Madhya Mein, Nayan Kothari Vand. Radha Kripa Kataaksh Bin, Mile Na Gokulchand. - Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati ‘Hare Krishn’, Shyam Shatak (07)The arched eyebrows rise like a fortress, with the eyes as its sealed chambers. Without the merciful, grace-filled glance of Śrī Rādhā, the vision and attainment of Gokulchand, Śrī Kṛṣṇa, are utterly impossible.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Rasikjan Ki Main Balihari - Shri Ali Madhuri Ji, Shri Nikunj Keli Madhuri, Sri Rasik Bhaktjan Mahimamrit (177.2)
hindi_text: (Pad Rekhta)Rasikjan Ki Main Balihari, Piya Pyari Jin Ur Dhari.Vrindavan Dham Mein Dolen, Amani Mande Bolen. [1]Sabhi Se Prem Hitkari, Trigun Se Riti Jin Nyari.Prem Mein Magan Gun Gaven, Madhuri Tinko Shirnaven. [2]- Shri Ali Madhuri Ji, Shri Nikunj Keli Madhuri, Sri Rasik Bhaktjan Mahimamrit (177.2)I offer myself in sacrifice to those rasika devotees in whose hearts the Divine Couple, Śrī Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa, eternally and exclusively dwell. They dwell in the sacred land of Vṛndāvan, free from false prestige, yet their words bestow honor upon all. [1]Loving toward everyone and devoted to the welfare of all, their love transcends the three modes of material nature. Absorbed in pure, selfless divine love, they ceaselessly sing the glories of the Divine Couple, Śrī Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa. Śrī Alī Mādhurī bows her head humbly at their feet. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Sanvar Sasi Sang Lasi Priya - ShriBhatt Devacharya, Yugal Shatak (67)
hindi_text: Sanvar Sasi Sang Lasi Priya, Bhari Saras Ras Chhand. Dolat Hain Shri Radhika, Ati Hi Aju Anand. - Shri Bhatt Devacharya, Yugal Shatak (67)Just as moonlight appears splendid with the moon, likewise Shri Radhika, immersed in divine bliss, shines supremely beautiful beside Shyamsundar. Today, she is swaying, overflowing with the ecstasy of love-bliss.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Kirtan Ke Yuth Dekh Utthi Umang Ek - Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati, Vrindavan Shatak (3)
hindi_text: (Kavitt)Kirtan Ke Yuth Dekh Utthi Umang Ek,Govardhan Ko Dekh Govardhan Dharaiya Ki. [1]Bhul Jata Gyan Sabhi, Dekh “Gyan Gudri” Ko,Chir Ghat Dekhkar, Chir Ke Churaiya Ki. [2]Seva Kunj Dekh Sudh Hoti Shyamsundar Ki,Vanshi Vat Dekh-Dekh, Vanshi Ke Bajaiya Ki. [3]Yamuna Hiloren Dekh Hilta Hriday Hay,Kalidah Dekh Yaad Aati Hai Kanhaiya Ki. [4]- Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati ‘Hare Krishn’, Vrindavan Shatak (3)In the sacred land of Śrī Vṛndāvan, the heart overflows with joy upon seeing groups of devotees singing in kīrtan-maṇḍalīs; a glance at Govardhan instantly evokes the memory of Lord Kṛṣṇa lifting this divine hill. [1]Seeing ‘Jñāna Guḍaḍī’, all acquired knowledge seems insignificant; a glimpse of ‘Cīra Ghāṭa’ immediately brings to mind the playful Lord Kṛṣṇa who stole the Gopīs’ clothes. [2]‘Sevā Kuñja’ awakens the divine remembrance of Śyāmasundar serving Śrī Rādhā; ‘Vāṁśīvaṭa’ enchants the mind with the sweet memory of the flute‑playing Kṛṣṇa. [3]The rippling waters of the Yamunā stir the heart with waves of divine love; Kālīdaha reminds one vividly of Kānhā’s heroic subduing of the serpent Kāliya. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Sakal Vibhav Saram Sarva Dharmaika Saram - Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (17.85)
hindi_text: Sakal Vibhav Saram, Sarva Dharmaika Saram, Sakal Bhajan Saram, Sarva Siddhaika Saram.Sakal Mahima Saram, Vastu Vrindavanantah, Sakal Madhurimambho Rashi Saram Viharam.- Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (17.85)The essence of all opulences, the essence of all religions, the essence of all devotional practices, the essence of all accomplishments, the essence of all glories, and the essence of all sweetness and rasas is none other than the Nitya Vihāra (eternal love-plays) of Śrī Dham Vṛndāvan.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Mere Shri Radharaman Ati Saroop Sukumar - Shri Lal Balbir Ji, Braj Binod, Shadritu Shatak, Doha (2)
hindi_text: Mere Shri Radharaman, Ati Saroop Sukumar. Koti Koti Rati Kaam Chhabi, In Par Darun Baar. - Shri Lal Balbir Ji, Braj Binod, Shadritu Shatak, Doha (2)My Shri Radharaman Lāla is supremely enchanting and tender in form. Upon that divine form, I would offer countless Kāmadeva (Cupids) and their consorts, Rati, again and again.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shri Vrindavipinesvari Ras Sindhu Bihari - Shri Bhatt Devacharya, Yugal Shatak (77)
hindi_text: (Doha)Pyari Preetam Paraspar, Rachyo Ang Anurag.Adhar Sudha Ras Det Hain, Let Syam Badbhag.(Pad) [Iktal, Raag-Vihagarau]Shri Vrindavipinesvari Ras Sindhu Bihari.Rachyo Paraspar Prem Chem, Badhyo Ati Bhari. [1]Arpyo Piy Hiy Pay Cain, Nij Adhar Sudhari.Shribhat Badbhagi Gopal, Piyo Ruchikari. [2]- Shri Bhatt Devacharya, Yugal Shatak (77)(Doha)Shri Priyā Ju and her beloved Shri Krishna are absorbed in the sweetness of divine conjugal love﻿. Their hearts overflow with the ocean of divine bliss. Blessed Shri Lālaji’s mind, like a bee, becomes intoxicated by drinking adharāmṛta﻿ (the nectar of the lips) of Shri Priya Ji.(Pada)Shri Bhatt Ji says — Queen of Vṛndāvan, Shri Rādhā, and Vṛndāvanvihārī Lāla are both the very ocean of rasa﻿. On the bower-bed, immersed in mutual love’s sweetness, waves of bliss surge through their hearts, and their entire beings overflow with divine bliss. [1]O Sakhi! When Shri Lālaji’s heart was filled with deep longing to taste adharāmṛta﻿, the supremely compassionate Shri Priyāji offered her own divine nectar in love. Shri Bhatt Ji says—Shri Gopāl Lāl, feeling supremely blessed, lovingly drank the nectar of Shri Priyāji. Thus, the divine couple joyfully engages in divine plays of love on the bed, granting bliss to all rasikas. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Kou Chhatr Leenai Kou - Shri Hati Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (23)
hindi_text: (Kavitt)Kou Chhatr Leenai Kou Chhahgir Keenai Kou,Beenai Le Prabeenai Ye Naveenen Sur Gaavati. [1]Kou Jari Jorai Kar Atar Gulab Borai,Lai Lai Alabeli Hathi Dhavan Tain Aavati. [2]Kou Chaur Dharai Kou Aarti Utarai Kou,Karti Salamen Kou Mujra Na Paavati. [3]Baithi Aan Takhat Pai Bakhat Biland Radhe,Bala Digpalan Ki Mala Pahiraavati. [4]- Shri Hati Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (23)One sakhī stands holding a royal canopy above Her, another holds a mirror before Her, while yet another sings sweet melodies, playing the vīṇā to please Her divine heart. [1]One lovingly adorns Her with garments of gold, another sprinkles fragrant rose water and perfume, and yet another rushes forward in eagerness to serve the enchanting Sovereign Queen, Śrī Rādhā. [2]One waves a fly‑whisk, another performs Her āratī; one offers prostrations in reverence, while another greets Her with folded hands in deep devotion. [3]Śrī Rādhā sits gracefully upon Her jeweled throne, while celestial queens lovingly place garlands around Her neck. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Keet Patang Pipilika Markat Bhring Mayur - Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay Shringar Shatak (97)
hindi_text: Keet Patang Pipilika, Markat Bhring Mayur.Jugalvihari Kijiye, Vrindavan Ki Dhoor.- Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay Shringar Shatak (97)Whether as an insect, a moth, an ant, a monkey, a bumblebee, or even a peacock — grant me any form that pleases You. O Divine Couple! Bless me to become one with the dust of Vṛndāvan, ever resting at Your holy lotus feet.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jaake Pad Neti Neti - Shri Lal Balbir Ji, Braj Binod, Shri Radha Shatak (60)
hindi_text: (Kavitt)Jaake Pad Neti Neti Bandat Sures Sesh,Tere Pad Sees Naay Thaadhe Kar Jori Ri. [1]Jetau Nat Nagar Tu Naagari Chhabeeli Baal,Kahaa Pratipaal Bhayi Aisi Mat Bhori Ri. [2]Lal Balbeer Mil Dou Ras Rang Keejai,Deejai Sukh Nainan Kau Maani Binai Mori Ri. [3]Rahi Rain Thori Ab Sain Karau Gori,Kunj Preetam Ke Sang Mili Keerati Kisori Ri. [4]- Shri Lal Balbir Ji, Braj Binod, Shri Radha Shatak (60)The One whose feet are worshiped even by Indra and Śeṣanāga, who glorify Him as “beyond all description” — that Supreme Brahman, Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa Himself, bows down with folded hands before Your lotus feet. [1]If He is the supreme master of divine play, then You are the supreme enchantress who captivates even Him, the most graceful and charming of all; tell me, O my tender‑hearted protectress, why do You behave so innocently today? [2]Śrī Lāl Balbir Jī humbly prays — O Rādhe! Please set aside Your loving pride and joyfully unite with Your Beloved, granting us, Your sahacarīs (companions), the bliss of witnessing that divine union. [3]O fair daughter of Vṛṣabhānu, beloved Rādhe! The night has nearly passed; the time has come — now lovingly repose with Your Beloved in the grove of divine pleasure. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Puran Prem Sudhanidhi Saar Ki - Braj Ke Sawaiya
hindi_text: (Sawaiya)Puran Prem Sudhaanidhi Saar Ki Moorati Manju Bani Ik Raajai.Keli Mahotsav Mein Hulsi Ras Ki Ghan Moorati Dooji Viraajai. [1]Radhika Ke Pad-Kanj Vilodat Morapakha Atihi Chhavi Chhaajai.Shri Barsane Sumandir Raajat Laadileelaal Ki Bolo Sadaajai. [2]- Braj Ke SawaiyaOn one side sits the beautiful Śrī Rādhā, who is the very source and essence of divine love; on the other, Śrī Kṛṣṇa, who is filled with the sweetness of rasa, is joyfully present in the keli-mahotsav (divine play festival). [1]Kṛṣṇa's peacock feather crown gently touches the lotus feet of Śrī Rādhā, making Śrī Rādhā's form even more charming. Let us always sing the praises of Ladilī lāl (Śrī Rādhā Kṛṣṇa), who dwells in the lovely temple of Barsāna. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Na Radha Na Radhapriyo - Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (14.60)
hindi_text: Na Radha Na Radhapriyo Naapi Vrinda-Vanam Naiva Vrindani Tat PremabhajamSadaa Yasya Hrada-Gochare Vaatha Vaachaam Prachaare Katham Tasya Rasa-Shrih.- Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (14.60)One whose heart Shri Radha, Shri Krishna, Shri Vrindavan, and Their loving rasika devotees (sahacharis) do not ever manifest — and from whose speech they are never spoken — how can such a person ever taste the most wondrous Rasa-Shri (Vrindavan Rasa)?
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jaat Rupa Takhat Pe Baithi Roop Rasi Radhe - Shri Hati Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (25)
hindi_text: (Kavitt)Jaat Roop Takhat Pai Baithi Roop Raasi Radhe,Angan Ki Prabha Prabhakar Ko Lajavati. [1]Cheer Chaaru Heer Haar Hiy Pehiraay Kar,Bhushan Bnaay Baal Saajan Sajaavati. [2]Atar Gulaab Lai Sugandhan Lagaavai Sabai,Chandan Chadhaay Bhaal Bhauran Bhagaavati. [3]Jori Jori Paani Devtaan Hoon Ki Rani Hathi,Koti Koti Kornis Jhuki Kai Bajaavati. [4]- Shri Hati Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (25)When Śrī Rādhā Mahārānī, the infinite mine of beauty, sits gracefully upon Her golden throne, the radiance of Her divine limbs shames even the brilliance of the sun. [1]Her intimate sakhīs lovingly adorn Her with beautiful garments, garlands of diamonds and pearls, and precious ornaments with their delicate hands. [2]They anoint Her with rose‑scented oils and fragrant essences, apply sandal paste to Her forehead, and gently wave away the bees drawn to Her divine fragrance. [3]Śrī Hathi Jī says — even the queens of the celestial gods come with folded hands, bowing countless times, playing kornish (a melodious ceremonial instrument), and offering reverent obeisance at the lotus feet of Śrī Rādhā Mahārānī. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Pashu Pakshi Pashan Hon - Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay Shringar Shatak (91)
hindi_text: Pashu Pakshi Paashaan Hon, Trin Anu Raj Braj Gail.Koop Baavari Keejiye, Lalit Kishori Chhail.- Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay Shringar Shatak (91)O Lalit Kishori (Shri Radha), please grant me the grace to become anything in the pathways of Braj — a bird, animal, stone, a blade of grass, or even a speck of dust. Even as a well, a stepwell, or a lifeless object, my only prayer is to never be born or dwell outside the dust of Braj-dham.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Radhanantaparadhat‌ Patatam - Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (14.100)
hindi_text: Radhanantaparadhat‌ Patatam Vadhambudhavanuddhara.Vrrindavanamapi Mandayata Iha Karunardradrrik‌ Prasare.- Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (14.100)The one who commits an offense against Shri Radha Maharani, because of those endless offenses, falls into the ocean of worldly obstacles and is deprived of deliverance. Even Shri Vrindavan itself does not show compassion to such an offender and keeps him deprived of its merciful glance.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Krishna-guru Dyuti Para Bahu Gayamana - Shri Kishori Ali, Radhashtak (01)
hindi_text: Krishna-guru Dyuti Para Bahu Gayamana Krrishnatate ViharatanvitaKrishnasara. Krishnanena Kamthamanushamjita DirghabahuhKrishnapriya Vasatu Me Hrridaye Sadaiva.- Shri Kishori Ali, Radhashtak (1)May Shri Radha, who is the guru of Krishn, supremely radiant, glorified in countless ways, who performs Vihāra (love-plays) along the banks of Yamunā, who embodies the very essence of Krishn, whose long arms embrace His neck, who is His dearest beloved, always dwell in my heart.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Kirati Kisori Vrishabhan Ki Dulari Radha - Shri Hati Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (99)
hindi_text: (Kavitt)Kirati Kisori Vrishabhan Ki Dulaari Radha,Sahaj Sakhin Lai Nikunjan Ko Dagari. [1]Charan Ki Chauki Ki Chamak Chaaru Angan Ki,Kayo Rang Rangan Ki Jyoti Braj Bagari. [2]Dekhai Pag Dwarei Varei Tan Man Pran Hathi,Roop Chak Chaundha Rahi Chauk Sab Nagari. [3]Kaidhau Sukhma Hai Kai Dama Hai Ke Tama Hai Kai,Uma Hai Induma Hai Kai Rama Hai Roop Aagari. [4]- Shri Hati Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (99)Śrī Vṛṣabhānu’s charming daughter Rādhā, along with Her sakhīs, is walking gracefully toward the path of the Nikunj (divine grove). [1]The divine presence of Her footprints has illuminated the land, casting a radiant glow that fills the entire Braj region with a fresh charm and spiritual splendor. [2]Whoever catches a glimpse of Śrī Rādhā’s sacred footprints at their threshold becomes overwhelmed, surrendering their body, mind, and soul at Her feet; Her beauty stuns the entire town. [3]People are amazed and wonder — what exactly is this beauty? Is it the embodiment of bliss? The essence of peace? Or the aura that dispels darkness (tam‑harinī ābhā)? Some say, “She is Pārvatī”; others say, “She is Indumā (the moon goddess)”; some believe, “She is Lakṣmī”; but in truth, She is none other than the ultimate pinnacle of beauty — Śrī Rādhā Mahārānī. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Madana Nada Taramgai - Shri Keshavachary, Govardhan Shatak (96)
hindi_text: Madana Nada Taramgairullasangopanari Hrridayachilachimanamamisham Samjihirshu.Brajapatitanayaravyo Dhivara Praudha Vamshi Kara Hita Mapi Vadityanta Tatrastu Vasa.- Shri Keshavachary, Govardhan Shatak (96)May I reside in the very Govardhan where Shri Krishna, the son of Nand, held His flute in His lotus hands and played its sweet melody, captivating the hearts of the beautiful cowherd maidens, overwhelmed with ecstatic waves of divine love.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jake Aganit Gunan Ko Gavat Ved Richan - Jagadguru Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Bhakti Shatak (94)
hindi_text: Jaake Aganit Gunan Ko, Gaavat Ved Richan.Daari Ke, Gaari Sunan, Soi Chhedat Sakhiyan.- Jagadguru Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Bhakti Shatak (94)Lord Shri Krishna, whose countless divine virtues are sung tirelessly by the four Vedas, that same supreme personality, in the land of Braj, considers it his highest fortune to mischievously tease the gopis and then be scolded by them with playful taunts like “Dārī ke!”.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Dhenu Duhat Mohan Thage - Shri Nagridas Ji (Maharaj Sawant Singh), Shri Nagridas Ji Ki Vani, Dohananandashtak (4)
hindi_text: Dhenu Duhat Mohan Thage, Radha Roop Nihar.Parat Dohani Tain Nikasi, Aendibaendi Dhaar.- Shri Nagridas Ji (Maharaj Sawant Singh), Shri Nagridas Ji Ki Vani, Dohananandashtak (4)While milking the cow, the moment Krishna beholds Shri Radha’s divine form, He becomes so entranced that the milk twists here and there instead of going directly into the bucket.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Namo Namastestu Paratparaayai - Shri Vanshi Ali, Shri Radha Stotra (1)
hindi_text: Namo Namastestu Paratparaayai Radhabhidhayai Nikhilashrayayai.Sakridgrinantastavanamaye Vai Te Twam Gatim Yantibhavpramuktah.- Shri Vanshi Ali, Shri Radha Stotra (1)I bow again and again to the one who is supreme among all, beyond whom nothing exists, whose name is Radha, and who is the shelter of all beings. Whoever remembers Her name even once surely becomes free from the bonds of worldly existence and attains Her supreme abode.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Giri-Pati Laagi Meru Meru - Shri Hati Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (96)
hindi_text: (Kavitt)Giri-Pati Laagi Meru Meru-Pati Laagi Bhoomi,Bhoomi-Pati Ses-Kol Kachh Neer Chaari Saun.Dig-Pati Laagi Dig-Palan Ke Haath Hathi,Sur-Pati Laagi Sur-Paal Chatradhaari Saun.Daan-Pati Karan Karan Pati Laagi Bali,Bali-Pati Laagi Kailaas Ke Vihaari Saun.Teenon Lok-Pati Braj-Pati Sau Laagi Hai,Braj-Pati Pati Laagi Vrishabhan Ki Dulaari Saun.- Shri Hati Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (96)Mighty Himalaya bows to Mount Meru, which rests humbly upon the Earth; Earth itself stands upheld by Śeṣanāga, Varāha, Kūrma, and the oceanic depths — none stands alone. [1]The ten directions are ruled by guardians like Indra, Yama, and Varuṇa — even Indra, King of heaven, bows to higher powers beyond. [2]Even the generous Karṇa and noble King Bali serve under the lordship of Mahādev, Lord Śiva. [3]Yet Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva — the triad of creation, preservation, and destruction — are under the authority of Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa of Vraja; and Śrī Kṛṣṇa Himself is under the command of Vṛṣabhānu‑nandinī, Śrī Rādhāraṇī. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jayati Jayati Radha Prema - Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (9.45)
hindi_text: jayati jayati rādhā premasārairagādhā, jayati jayati kṛṣṇastadbhasāpāratṛṣṇaḥ jayati jayati vṛndaṃ satsakhīnāṃ dvayaikyaṃ, jayati jayati vṛndākānanaṃ tatsvadhāma- Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (9.45)Glory, glory to Radha, a fathomless ocean of the essence of divine love! Glory, glory to Krishna, who is endlessly thirsty for the nectar of Radha-rasa! Glory, glory to their Sakhis that yearn for the union of this divine couple! Glory, glory to Sri Vrindavan, their very own eternal abode!
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jugal Bihari Virah Mein Nahin Ab Avkas - Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay Shringar Shatak (98)
hindi_text: Jugal Bihari Virah Mein, Nahin Ab Avkas.Lalitkishori Deejiye, Sri Vrindaban Vas.- Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay Shringar Shatak (98)The separation from the divine couple, Shri Radha Krishna, who perform Nitya Vihara, is now unbearable. Shri Lalita Kishori humbly pleads, O Sri Radha! Please bestow your grace and grant me residence in Shri Vrindavan.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shyam Batayo Nain Mein - ShriBhatt Devacharya, Yugal Shatak (30)
hindi_text: Syam Batayo Nain Mein, Rahi Samujhi Sukunwari.Charan Lagyo Jab Kahayou Tab, Harshi Laal Nihari.- Shri Bhatt Devacharya, Yugal Shatak (30)Shri Krishna pleaded to the sulking Shri Radha through His longing eyes, and She silently acknowledged His plea. But when He placed His head at Her lotus feet in deep humility, Her heart melted, and She was fully pleased.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Tum Mere They Rahoge Yah Shruti Vachan Tihar - Jagadguru Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Bhakti Shatak (81)
hindi_text: Tum Mere They Rahoge, Yah Shruti Vachan Tihar.Adham Udharan Naath Puni, Kaahe Mohin Bisar.- Jagadguru Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Bhakti Shatak (81)O Shri Krishna! Though I am fallen, still You have declared in the Vedas: “Since eternity, you were Mine, and you will remain Mine forever.” Then why, O Uplifter of the fallen, have You forgotten me?
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Vrindavan Vriksha Hain Ki Parijat - Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati, Vrindavan Shatak (6)
hindi_text: (Kavitt)Vrindavan-Vriksha Hain Ki Paarijat Nandan Ke,Vrindavan-Shakha Ya Prem-Anjan-Shalaka Hain.Vrindavan-Raj Ya Rajat Renu-Raj Rahi,Vrindavan Path Hain Ki Prem-Puri-Naka Hain.Vrindavan-Kunj Ya Indra-Bhavan Shobhit Hain,Vrindavan-Dham Ya Niketan Prabha Ka Hain.Vrindavan-Phool Hain Ki Taravali Utari Ye,Vrindavan-Pat Hain Ki Prem Ki Pataka Hain.- Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati ‘Hare Krishn’, Vrindavan Shatak (6)Are these trees of Vṛndāvan or celestial Pārijāta trees in disguise?Are these branches, or wands touched with the collyrium of divine love? [1]Are these grains of Vṛndāvan’s dust, or shining pearls of purest silver scattered upon the earth?Are these pathways or the very gateways into the realm of divine love? [2]Are these bowers of Vṛndāvan, or dwellings resplendent beyond even Indra’s celestial palaces?Is this land just Vṛndāvan, or the very embodiment of beauty and divine radiance? [3]Are these flowers, or garlands of stars falling from the cosmos with divine fragrance?Are these Vṛndāvan’s leaves or fluttering flags of divine love? [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: अहु राधे वृषभानु की - श्री भट्ट देवाचार्य, युगल शतक (81)
sanskrit_text:
अहु राधे वृषभानु की, कुँवरी किसोरी बाल।
थोरी बै भौरीहि में, मोहे मोहन लाल॥
- श्री भट्ट देवाचार्य, युगल शतक (81)
hindi_text: हे राधे! वृषभानुनन्दिनी, आपने श्री कृष्ण (मोहनलाल) को उनकी अल्प वयस (किशोर अवस्था) और निष्कपट भोलेपन में ही मोहित कर लिया है।
english_text:
Ahu Radhe Vrishabhanu Ki, Kuvari Kisori Baal.
Thori Bai Bhaurihi Mein, Mohe Mohan Laal.
- Shri Bhatt Devacharya, Yugal Shatak (81)

O Radhika, Your simple and innocent nature has captivated the heart of Shri Mohan Lal Krishn who captures the Heart of all.
english_translation:
Ahu Radhe Vrishabhanu Ki, Kuvari Kisori Baal.
Thori Bai Bhaurihi Mein, Mohe Mohan Laal.
- Shri Bhatt Devacharya, Yugal Shatak (81)

O Radhika, Your simple and innocent nature has captivated the heart of Shri Mohan Lal Krishn who captures the Heart of all.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Mohan Tadag Bag Phool Phal Mohan Hain - Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati, Vrindavan Shatak (14)
hindi_text: (Kavitt)Mohan Tadag Bag Phool Phal Mohan Hain,Mohan Gaay Giri Govardhan Lalam Hai. [1]Mohan Man Mohan Dhar Bahai Yamuna Ki,Mohan Madhupuri Mohan Nand Gram Hai. [2]Mohan Hain Gopijan Gwal Bal Mohan Hain,Mohan Shri Radha Aur Mohan Shri Shyam Hai. [3]Mohan Hain Lata Pata Kunj Sab Mohan Hain,Mohan Swaroop Yah Vrindavan Dham Hai. [4]- Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati ‘Hare Krishn’, Vrindavan Shatak (14)The enchanting lakes, blooming gardens, and their fruits and flowers — all captivate the heart; the gentle cows, the majestic Govardhan Hill — everything in this sacred land is enchanting. [1]The flowing waters of Yamunā hold an irresistible charm. Mathurā and Nandgaon all radiate divine enchantment. [2]The Gopīs and the young cowherd boys embody divine enchantment. Śrī Rādhā and Śrī Śyām Themselves are the very essence of this divine charm. [3]Vines, leaves, and every kuñj are enchanting, for the entire land of Vṛndāvan is an embodiment of divine enchantment, a manifestation of Śrī Kṛṣṇa Himself. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jog Jagy Jap Tap Teerath Gavan Vrat - Shri Lal Balbir Ji, Braj Binod, Shri Radha Shatak (105)
hindi_text: (Kavitt)Jog Jagy Jap Tap Teerath Gavan Vrat,Kabahun Na Haridas Shravan Katha Kari. [1]Bhramana Bhramayau Maya Moh Mad Liptaayau,Vrithan Jag Baadan Mein Umar Bita Kari. [2]Lal Balbir Mati Heen Main Malin Peen,Sewa Rasikan Tanhoon Ki Nahin Ja Kari. [3]Krishn Ali Ju Ki Kripa Drishti Bar Paay Paay,Radha Thakurayan Ke Paayan Ki Chaakari. [4] - Shri Lal Balbir Ji, Braj Binod, Shri Radha Shatak (105)Neither did I perform yogic practices, sacrifices, chanting, austerities, or pilgrimages, nor did I ever listen to the sacred stories of Lord Hari. [1]Wandering aimlessly, entangled in illusion, bound by attachment and ego, I wasted my whole life in useless worldly debates. [2]Foolish, impure, and steeped in sorrow, not even once did I serve the true rasika devotees. [3]Yet by the mere glimpse of grace from Kṛṣṇa Ali Jū, my beloved Gurudev, I have been blessed to become a humble maidservant at the lotus feet of Śrī Rādhā Thākuraṇī. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Jai Jai Shri Radharaman Jai Jai Shri Sukharas - Shri Lal Balbir Ji, Braj Binod, Shadritu Shatak, Doha (1)
hindi_text: Jai Jai Shri Radharaman, Jai Jai Shri Sukharas,Jai Jai Rasikan Pran Dhan, Mam Ur Karo Nivas.- Shri Lal Balbir Ji, Braj Binod, Shadritu Shatak, Doha (1)Glory to Shri Radharaman Lal Ji, the very embodiment of divine bliss! Glory to the source of life and true wealth of all rasika devotees! O Radharaman Lal, please bestow your mercy and kindly reside eternally within my heart.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Shakti Nahi Dhruv Si Akhand Tap Kaise Karun - Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati, Vrindavan Shatak (76)
hindi_text: (Kavitt)Shakti Nahi Dhruv Si Akhand Tap Kaise Karun,Bhakti Na Prahlad Si Ram Ram Kehne Ki. [1]Ambarish Tuly Dridh Vrat Ka Niyam Nahi,Harishchandra Si Na Dridhata Kasht Sahne Ki. [2]Moradhwaj Jaisa Mujhe Dharm Ka Bhi Prem Nahi,Shraddha Nahi Sur Si Prem-Path Gahne Ki. [3]Aradhana Na Aur Koi Kar Sakta Nath,Sadhana Ek Meri Vrindavan Rahne Ki. [4]- Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati ‘Hare Krishn’, Vrindavan Shatak (76)O Lord! I do not possess the strength like Dhruva to perform unwavering penance,Nor do I have the devotion like Prahlāda to chant Your holy name constantly. [1]I cannot uphold vows with the firmness of King Ambarīṣa,Nor do I have the endurance like Harishchandra to bear immense hardships. [2]I lack the love for righteousness like Moradhwaj,Nor do I have the unwavering faith like Śrī Sūrdās in this path of divine love. [3]O Lord! I am incapable of performing any other spiritual practice,My only true sādhanā is to reside in Śrī Vṛndāvan Dham. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Phoole Hain Palaas Aas Paas - Shri Lal Balbir Ji, Braj Binod, Shadritu Shatak, Basant Ritu (26)
hindi_text: (Kavitta)Phoole Hain Palaas Aas Paas Ban Baagan Mein,Madhur Madhur Ter Kokoila Lagai Hai. [1]Gunjat Madhur Punj Kunj Kunjan Mein,Sheetal Sugandh Mand Pavan Suhai Hai. [2]‘Lal Balveer’ Bas Baalam Videsh Rahe,Ko Kare Sahay Peer Main Ko Savai Hai. [3]Pathik Praveen Pyare Itni Kripa Karike,Kahiyo Jaay Kant Soun Basant Ritu Aai Hai. [4]- Shri Lal Balbir Ji, Braj Binod, Shadritu Shatak, Basant Ritu (26)The Pālāś trees have blossomed across the forests and gardens, and the cuckoo sings a sweet melody. [1]The humming of bees fills the bowers, and the gentle, fragrant breeze brings joy. [2]Lāl Balveer says, “If the beloved is far away in a distant land, who will ease this sorrow, as my pain only grows?” [3]O dear traveler, have mercy and convey this message; tell my beloved Śyāmasundara that the season of spring has arrived!. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Naval Basant Naval Shri Vrindavan - Shri Bhatt Devacharya, Yugal Shatak (84)
hindi_text: (Doha)Nav Kishor Nav Nagari, Nav Sab Saunjaru Saaj.Nav Vrindavan Nav Kusum, Nav Basant Rituraj.(Pad) [Iktal, Raag-Basant]Naval Basant Naval Shri Vrindavan, Naval Hi Phule Phool.Naval Hi Kanh Naval Sab Gopi, Nirat Tat Ekai Tool. [1]Naval Hi Sashi Jwadi Kunkuma, Naval Hi Basan Amool.Naval Hi Chhint Bani Kesar Ki, Mentat Manmath Sool. [2]Naval Gulal Udai Rang Booka, Naval Pavan Kai Jhool.Naval Hi Baje Bajat Shri Bhatt, Kalindi Ke Kool. [3]- Shri Bhatt Devacharya, Yugal Shatak (84)(Doha)Ever-new is ‘Kishor’ (Shri Krishna), ever-new is ‘Nagari’ (Shri Radha), everything is adorned in fresh splendor.Ever-new is Vrindavan, ever-new are the blossoms, and ever-new is the king of seasons, spring (Basant).(Pada)As Basant, the king of seasons, arrives, Shri Vrindavan glows with ever-new splendor, its blossoming flowers brimming with freshness.Ever-youthful is Krishna, and ever-youthful are all the gopis, among whom Shri Vrishabhanu Nandini (Sri Radha) gracefully dances with Lalji in perfect harmony. [1]The freshness of spring is further enhanced by the newly blossomed branches of fragrant sandalwood trees. Ever-new priceless garments are adorned with fresh saffron sprays, and the ever-radiant gopis, who wear these divine attires, appear ever-new, soothing the burning pangs of love. [2]Ever-new colors of gulala (scented powder), fresh abira, and vibrant roli (vermilion) are playfully tossed into the air. Ever-fresh is the breeze swaying gently, ever-fresh is the music played in this king of seasons, Basant, on the banks of the Yamuna, says Shri Bhata Devacharya. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Swarg Mein Kahaan Hai Madhur Dhvani Radhe Radhe Ki - Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati, Vrindavan Shatak (12)
hindi_text: (Kavitt)Swarg Mein Kahaan Hai Madhur Dhvani Radhe Radhe Ki,Swarg Mein Kahaan Kalit Kunj Abhiraam Hai. [1]Swarg Mein Kahaan Bheer Gopi Gaay Gwaal Waale Ki,Swarg Mein Kahaan Pulin Yamuna Lalaam Hai. [2]Swarg Mein Saras Braj Bhasha Ka Prachaar Kahaan,Swarg Mein Kahaan Makhhan Chor Ghanashyam Hai. [3]Swarg Mein Amit Sukh Itna Aapaar Kahaan,Swarg Se Bhi Shreshth Yah Vrindavan Dhaam Hai. [4]- Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati ‘Hare Krishn’, Vrindavan Shatak (12)Where can one hear the sweet melody of ‘Rādhe Rādhe’ in heaven?Where in heaven are those enchanting bowers and forests? [1]Where can one see the crowds of gopīs, cows, and cowherds in heaven?Where in heaven are the beautiful banks of the Yamunā? [2]Where in heaven is such a sweet and nectar‑like Brajbhāṣā spoken?Where in heaven can one find the butter‑thief (Ghanshyām) Śrī Kṛṣṇa? [3]Where in heaven is such infinite and unparalleled bliss found?Ḍaṃḍī Swāmī Śrī Hare Krishṇānand Saraswatī Jī says that this Vṛndāvan Dham is far superior to heaven itself. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Munin Ke Vrindan Ke Vrinda Sada - Shri Lal Balbir Ji, Sri Radha Shatak (18)
hindi_text: (Kavitt)Munin Ke Vrindan Ke Vrind Sada Vande Tumhe,Anand Ke Kande Nandanandai Sang Lijiye. [1]Teen Lok Jeevan Ke Sokan Ki Harn,Prasanna Mukh Pankaj Son Charan Saran Dijiye. [2]Nikunj Bhu Vilasini Prakashani Hau Gyan Ki,Vijendra Bhan Nandani Araj Suni Lijiye. [3]Kahat Bar Bar Main Tihare Darbar Mein,‘Sulal Balbir’ Pai Kripa Kataksh Kijiye. [4]- Shri Lal Balbir Ji, Braj Binod, Shri Radha Shatak (18)All sages bow at Your lotus feet; You are the eternal consort of Braj’s prince, Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the source of bliss. [1]You are the remover of sorrows across the three worlds, with a cheerful face blooming like a lotus. Kindly grant me refuge at Your lotus feet. [2]You, who delight in the love‑plays of the Nikunj forest, are the illuminator of divine wisdom and the daughter of King Vṛṣabhānu, the noblest of kings. Please graciously hear my prayer. [3]Śrī Lāl Balbir says, “I repeatedly offer my plea to Your court — cast Your merciful glance upon me”. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Kah Deta Jhat Jeev Se - Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati ‘Hare Krishn’, Shyam Shatak (42)
hindi_text: Kah Deta Jhat Jeev Se, Rat Tu Radhe Shyam.Swayam Kahin Aata Nikal, Man Tu Bada Haram.- Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati ‘Hare Krishn’, Shyam Shatak (42)O mind, you quickly compel the tongue to chant ‘Radhe Shyam,’ yet you remain deceitful and cunning, wandering aimlessly elsewhere on your own.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Kechidbhajanti Krritino Girijamathanye - Shri Keshavachary, Govardhan Shatak (53)
hindi_text: kecidbhajanti kṛtino girijāmathānyesevanti bhargamapare divasādhināthaṃeke gaṇādhipa surādhipa śaṃkarādīnsevantvahaṃ girivaraṃ śaraṇaṃ brajāmi- Shri Keshavachary, Govardhan Shatak (53)Some find their devotion in worshiping Girija Devi (Parvati), others bow to Lord Shiva. Some serve Surya Bhagwan (the Sun God), while others revere Lord Ganesha, Indra, or Shankar Ji. Let each follow their chosen deity; as for me, my heart and faith rest solely in the refuge of Shri Govardhan Ji.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Kantedar Karil Ke Vriksh Jis Bhoomi Par - Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati ‘Hare Krishn’, Vrindavan Shatak (30)
hindi_text: (Kavitt)Kantedar Karil Ke Vriksh Jis Bhoomi Par,Deta Dikhalayi Jahan Khara Jal Koop Hai. [1]Gari De Bolte Brajbasi Sab Aapas Mein,Anna Phal Heen Dhara Khaadar Kuroop Hai. [2]Paakar Ke Chhaak Chhachh Gauyen Charata Phire,Phir Bhi Banaya Use Svarg Se Anoop Hai. [3]Aisa Jo Manmauji Mast Thakur Triloki Ka,Rakshak Hamara Vahi Vrindavan Bhoop Hai. [4]- Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati ‘Hare Krishn’, Vrindavan Shatak (30)The land is filled with thorny Karīla trees, and its wells hold only salty water. [1]Where the Brajvāsīs converse with each other in abusive language, the land itself remains barren, devoid of crops and fruits, and steeped in desolation. [2]Yet, Śrī Kṛṣṇa roams through this land, drinking buttermilk and grazing cows, transforming Vṛndāvan into a place more beautiful than heaven itself. [3]That rapturous Lord, Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the ruler of the three worlds, is the king of Vṛndāvan and our beloved protector. [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Bandon Pag Pankaj Sada Nandanandan Brajchand - Shri Hati Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (6)
hindi_text: Bandon Pag Pankaj Sada, Nandanandan Brajchand.Radhasat Baranat Karat, Phir Na Paron Bhav-Phand.- Shri Hati Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (6)I humbly bow to the lotus feet of Sri Krishna, the moon of Braj and beloved son of Nanda, whose grace has granted me the ability to compose “Radha Shat” (Radha Sudha Shatak). May I be forever liberated from the bondage of worldly existence.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Mo Mana Kab Anurgaihai - Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay Shringar Shatak (120)
hindi_text: Mo Mana Kab Anurgaihai, Jugul Kamalpag Teer.Jyon Pyaase Ki Laalsa, Nirmal Seetal Neer.- Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay Shringar Shatak (120)When will my mind become devoted to the lotus feet of the divine couple, Sri Radha Krishn, with the same intensity that a thirsty person longs for cool and pure water?
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: मेरी टेर सुनो सुकुमारी - श्री लाल बलबीर, वृन्दावन शतक (53)
sanskrit_text:
मेरी टेर सुनो सुकुमारी। [1]
अखिल लोक चूड़ामणि सुन्दर मनमोहन की प्यारी॥ [2]
परम उदार दयानिधि नागरि दीनन ओर निहारी। [3]
दासी जानि कीजिये स्वामिनि महल टहल अधिकारी॥ [4]
- श्री लाल बलबीर, वृन्दावन शतक (53)
hindi_text:
श्री लाल बलबीर श्री राधा से प्रार्थना करते हैं: “हे सुकुमारी जू, कृप्या मेरी विनती सुनें, आप श्री कृष्ण की प्रिया हैं जो तीनों लोकों के स्वामी हैं। [1 & 2]
आप सबसे उदार और दयालु हैं, और मैं एक दीन हूँ, कृप्या मेरी ओर भी निहार लीजिए। [3]
श्री लाल बलबीर कहते हैं, कृप्या मुझे अपनी दासी जान अपने महल की टहल प्रदान करें।" [4]
english_text:
Meri Ter Suno Sukumari. [1]
Akhil Lok Choodamani Sundar Manmohan Ki Pyari. [2]
Param Udaar Dayanidhi Naagari Deenan Or Nihaari. [3]
Dasi Jaani Keejiye Swamini Mahal Tahal Adhikari. [4]
- Shri Lal Balbir, Vrindavan Shatak (53)

Shri Lal Balbir prays to Shri Radha: “O goddess who is ever-young, Please listen to my plea! [1]
You are the beloved of Shri Krishn who is the supreme personality of Godhead. [2]
You are the most generous and gracious personality, however, I am a destitute, please look at me as well. [2]
Please provide me the service of Your Nikunj palace, considering me as your maidservant, says Shri Lal Balbir.” [4]
english_translation:
Meri Ter Suno Sukumari. [1]
Akhil Lok Choodamani Sundar Manmohan Ki Pyari. [2]
Param Udaar Dayanidhi Naagari Deenan Or Nihaari. [3]
Dasi Jaani Keejiye Swamini Mahal Tahal Adhikari. [4]
- Shri Lal Balbir, Vrindavan Shatak (53)

Shri Lal Balbir prays to Shri Radha: “O goddess who is ever-young, Please listen to my plea! [1]
You are the beloved of Shri Krishn who is the supreme personality of Godhead. [2]
You are the most generous and gracious personality, however, I am a destitute, please look at me as well. [2]
Please provide me the service of Your Nikunj palace, considering me as your maidservant, says Shri Lal Balbir.” [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: सब साधन सम्पन्न कहँ - जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज, भक्ति शतक (39)
sanskrit_text:
सब साधन सम्पन्न कहँ, पुछत सब संसार।
साधनहीन प्रपन्न कहँ, पुछत नंदकुमार॥
- जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज, भक्ति शतक (39)
hindi_text: संसारी लोग उसी से प्रेम करते हैं, जिसके पास सांसारिक वैभव होता है; किन्तु श्यामसुन्दर तो अकिंचन जनों से ही प्रेम करते हैं।
english_text:
Sab Sadhan Sampann Kahn, Poochat Sab Sansar.
Sadhan-Heen Prapann Kahn, Poochat Nandkumar.
- Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Bhakti Shatak (39)

Worldly people love those in the world who have wealth and prestige. But, Nandkumar Krishn loves and takes care of those who are humble and destitute.
english_translation:
Sab Sadhan Sampann Kahn, Poochat Sab Sansar.
Sadhan-Heen Prapann Kahn, Poochat Nandkumar.
- Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Bhakti Shatak (39)

Worldly people love those in the world who have wealth and prestige. But, Nandkumar Krishn loves and takes care of those who are humble and destitute.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: अतिसाहसमाचरितं विरुध्य - श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (9.14)
sanskrit_text:
अतिसाहसमाचरितं विरुध्य गुरुशास्त्राविद्वद्वर्यैः।
त्वयि वृन्दावन! आप वासायेन्द्रियवशमप्यतो न हि त्यज माम्॥
- श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (9.14)
hindi_text: हे श्रीवृन्दावन! आप में वास करने के लिए इन्द्रियों के पराधीन होकर मेंने श्रेष्ठ गुरु तथा शास्त्र-वेत्ताओं से विमुख आचरण करके अत्यंत साहस का परिचय दिया है, अतः मुझे त्याग मत देना।
english_text:
Atisaahasamaacharitam Virudhy Gurushaastraavidvadvaryaih.
Tvayi Vrindavan! Aap Vaasaayendriyavashamapyato Na Hi Tyaj Maam.
- Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (9.14)

O Vrindavan, even though I am reckless, even though my actions are opposed by the most learnt gurus and theologians, and even though I am a slave to my senses, please allow me to reside within your boundaries. Please do not abandon me.
english_translation:
Atisaahasamaacharitam Virudhy Gurushaastraavidvadvaryaih.
Tvayi Vrindavan! Aap Vaasaayendriyavashamapyato Na Hi Tyaj Maam.
- Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (9.14)

O Vrindavan, even though I am reckless, even though my actions are opposed by the most learnt gurus and theologians, and even though I am a slave to my senses, please allow me to reside within your boundaries. Please do not abandon me.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: अपि सर्वधर्महीनः सर्वकुकर्मावलेश्च निर्माता - श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (9.13)
sanskrit_text:
अपि सर्वधर्महीनः सर्वकुकर्मावलेश्च निर्माता।
राधेति सिद्धमन्त्रं द्व्यक्षरमुच्चार्य किं न सिध्येयम्?॥
- श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (9.13)
hindi_text: सर्व धर्महीन होकर भी, सब कुकर्म करते हुए भी, ‘‘राधा’’ इन दो अक्षरों का सिद्ध-मन्त्र उच्चारण करके क्या तू भजन की सिद्धि को प्राप्त नहीं कर सकता?
english_text:
Api Sarvadharmaheenah ​​sarvakukarmaavaleshch Nirmaata.
Radheti Siddhamantram Dvyaksharamuchchaary Kim Na Sidhyeyam?
- Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (9.13)

Even if you are a sinner and devoid of every good karma, still, will you not able to attain spiritual perfection simply by chanting the two-syllable mantra "Radha", which is a "Siddha Mantra"?
english_translation:
Api Sarvadharmaheenah ​​sarvakukarmaavaleshch Nirmaata.
Radheti Siddhamantram Dvyaksharamuchchaary Kim Na Sidhyeyam?
- Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (9.13)

Even if you are a sinner and devoid of every good karma, still, will you not able to attain spiritual perfection simply by chanting the two-syllable mantra "Radha", which is a "Siddha Mantra"?
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: सारद नारद सेस - श्री लाल बलबीर जी, ब्रज बिनोद, श्रीराधा शतक (3)
sanskrit_text:
सारद नारद सेस, सुरपति पसुपति प्रजापति।
बंदत रहैं हमेस, श्रीवृषभानु कुमारि पद॥
- श्री लाल बलबीर जी, ब्रज बिनोद, श्रीराधा शतक (3)
hindi_text: सरस्वती, भक्त नारद, भगवान अनन्त शेष, इन्द्र, भगवान शिव और प्रजापति आदि भी सदैव वृषभानु-नन्दिनी श्री राधा के चरण-कमलों की वन्दना करते रहते हैं।
english_text:
Sarad Narad Ses, Surpati Pasupati Prajapati.
Bandat Rahain Hames, ShriVrishbhanu Kumari Pada.
- Shri Lal Balbir Ji, Braj Binod, ShriRadha Shatak (3)

Saraswati (the goddess of learning), Bhakta Narada, Lord Anant Shesh, great sages, Lord Shiva and Lord Bhrama etc always worship the lotus feet of Shri Radha.
english_translation:
Sarad Narad Ses, Surpati Pasupati Prajapati.
Bandat Rahain Hames, ShriVrishbhanu Kumari Pada.
- Shri Lal Balbir Ji, Braj Binod, ShriRadha Shatak (3)

Saraswati (the goddess of learning), Bhakta Narada, Lord Anant Shesh, great sages, Lord Shiva and Lord Bhrama etc always worship the lotus feet of Shri Radha.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: दोऊ मिल करत भामती बतियाँ - श्री भट्ट देवाचार्य, युगल शतक (75)
sanskrit_text:
(राग विहागरौ, ताल चम्पक)
दोऊ मिल करत भामती बतियाँ। [1]
मदन गोपाल कुँवर राधे संग नखमनि अंक लिखत उर छतियाँ॥ [2]
तेसी छिरक रही उजियारी पून्यो चंद शरद की रतियाँ। [3]
केल रूप यह यमुना श्री भट वृन्दावन फूल्यो बहु भतियाँ॥ [4]
- श्री भट्ट देवाचार्य, युगल शतक (75)
hindi_text:
आज दोनों (श्री प्यारी जू एवं श्री प्यारे जू) मिल कर बातें कर रहे हैं। [1]
व्रजराज कुंवर श्री मदन गोपाल एवं वृषभानु कुंवरी श्री राधा एक संग एक दूसरे के वक्ष स्थलों पर नखमणि से लिख रहे हैं, और उनके नखमणियों के चिन्ह उनके वक्ष स्थलों पर अंकित हो गए हैं। [2]
दोनों की अंग कांति शरद पुर्णिमा के चंद्र की कांति से भी उज्ज्वल भास रही है। [3]
श्री भट्ट देवाचार्य कहते हैं, "श्री वृन्दावन मे यमुना के किनारे दोनों (प्रिया प्रियतम) नित्य केली लीला पारायण विहार कर रहे हैं।" [4]
english_text:
(Raag Vihagarau, Taal Champak)
Dou Mil Karat Bhaamati Batiyaan. [1]
Madan Gopal Kunvar Radhe Sang Nakhmani Ank Likhat Ur Chhatiyaan. [2]
Tesi Chhirak Rahi Ujiyaari Punyo Chand Sharad Ki Ratiyaan. [3]
Kel Roop Yah Yamuna Shri Bhatt Vrindavan Phulyo Bahu Bhatiyaan. [4]
- Shri Bhatt Devacharya, Yugal Shatak (75)

The Divine Couple are enjoying a sweet and loving conversation. [1]
Sri Krishn the enchanting Cowherd and the Maiden Shri Radha write Their names on Each Others chest with Their jewel-like nails. [2]
The effulgence that diffuses from Their united Form is brighter than the full moon in the autumnal month of Sharad! [3]
Shri Bhatt Devacharya says "thus is the beautiful Form of Their playfulness which blossoms in so many diverse and lovely ways on the banks of the Sri Yamuna River and in Shri Vrindavan." [4]
english_translation:
(Raag Vihagarau, Taal Champak)
Dou Mil Karat Bhaamati Batiyaan. [1]
Madan Gopal Kunvar Radhe Sang Nakhmani Ank Likhat Ur Chhatiyaan. [2]
Tesi Chhirak Rahi Ujiyaari Punyo Chand Sharad Ki Ratiyaan. [3]
Kel Roop Yah Yamuna Shri Bhatt Vrindavan Phulyo Bahu Bhatiyaan. [4]
- Shri Bhatt Devacharya, Yugal Shatak (75)

The Divine Couple are enjoying a sweet and loving conversation. [1]
Sri Krishn the enchanting Cowherd and the Maiden Shri Radha write Their names on Each Others chest with Their jewel-like nails. [2]
The effulgence that diffuses from Their united Form is brighter than the full moon in the autumnal month of Sharad! [3]
Shri Bhatt Devacharya says "thus is the beautiful Form of Their playfulness which blossoms in so many diverse and lovely ways on the banks of the Sri Yamuna River and in Shri Vrindavan." [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: श्री वृषभानु सुता पद पंकज - श्री लाल बलबीर जी, ब्रज बिनोद,श्रीराधा शतक (74)
sanskrit_text:
(सवैया)
श्री वृषभानु सुता पद पंकज मेरी, सदां यह जीवन मूर है। [1]
याही के नाम सो ध्यान रहै, नित जाकें रटे जग कंटक दूर हैं॥ [2]
श्रीवनराज निवास दियो, जिन और दियो सुख हू भरपूर है। [3]
याकौं बिसार जो औरै भजौं, 'बलबीर' जू जानिये तौ मुख धूर है॥ [4]
- श्री लाल बलबीर जी, ब्रज बिनोद,श्रीराधा शतक (74)
hindi_text:
वृषभानु नन्दिनी श्री राधा जू के चरण-कमल ही सदा मेरे प्राण-धन हैं। [1]

मेरे मन में नित्य केवल श्रीराधा के नाम का ही ध्यान रहता है, जिससे संसार के सभी कांटे और विघ्न दूर हो जाते हैं। [2]

श्रीराधाजू ने ही मुझे श्रीवृंदावन धाम का अमूल्य वास दिया है और सभी सुखों का सार, अपने चरणों की भक्ति, प्रदान की है। [3]

श्रीलाल बलबीर कहते हैं—“जो जीव ऐसी परम करुणामयी किशोरी जी को भूलकर किसी और का भजन करता है, उस जीव के मुख में धूल पड़ेगी; धिक्कार है उसके जीवन को।” [4]
english_text:
(Sawaiya)
Shri Vrishbhanu Suta Pad Pankaj Meri Sadaan Yah Jeevan Moor Hai. [1]
Yaahi Ke Naam So Dhyaan Rahai Nit Jaakein Rate Jag Kantak Door Hain. [2]
Shrivanraaj Nivaas Diyo Jin Aur Diyo Sukh Hu Bharpoor Hai. [3]
Yaakaun Bisaar Jo Aurai Bhajaun Balbir Ju Jaaniye Tau Mukh Dhoor Hai. [4]
- Shri Lal Balbir Ji, Braj Binod, ShriRadha Shatak (74)

The lotus feet of Śrī Rādhā alone are the essence of my life. [1]

Ceaseless remembrance of Her name erases the filthy material world. [2]

Śrī Rādhā-jū alone has granted me the priceless abode of Śrī Vṛndāvana Dhāma and the essence of all pleasures. [3]

Śrī Lāl Balbīr says—“Anyone who, forgetting such a supremely compassionate Kishorī-jī, worships someone else, let soil be filled in His mouth as his life is utterly disgraceful”. [4]

title: किं करोम्यहमुन्मत्तो यत् किंचत प्रलपाम्यलम् - श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (4.33)
sanskrit_text:
किं करोम्यहमुन्मत्तो यत् किंचत प्रलपाम्यलम्।
ज्ञान-भक्ति-विरक्त्यादि व्यार्थं वृन्दावनं विना॥
- श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (4.33)
hindi_text: क्या करूँ? मैं तो पागल हो गया हूँ। जो कुछ प्रलाप करता हूँ- उससे ही क्या होगा? श्रीवृन्दावन के (आश्रय) बिना ज्ञान, भक्ति, वैराग्य आदि सब व्यर्थ हैं।
english_text:
Kim Karomyahamunmatto Yat Kinchat Pralapaamyalam.
Gyaan-Bhakti-Viraktyaadi Vyaartham Vrindavanam Vina.
- Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (4.33)

What should I do? I have become a madman. What can I do? I will just say this one thing: Knowledge, bhakti, and renunciation are worthless without Vrindavan.
english_translation:
Kim Karomyahamunmatto Yat Kinchat Pralapaamyalam.
Gyaan-Bhakti-Viraktyaadi Vyaartham Vrindavanam Vina.
- Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (4.33)

What should I do? I have become a madman. What can I do? I will just say this one thing: Knowledge, bhakti, and renunciation are worthless without Vrindavan.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: श्री वृषभानु कुमारि - श्री लाल बलबीर जी, ब्रज बिनोद, श्रीराधा शतक (2)
sanskrit_text:
श्री वृषभानु कुमारि, परम उदार कृपाल तुम।
दासी मोहि बिचारि, टहल महल की दीजिये॥
- श्री लाल बलबीर जी, ब्रज बिनोद, श्रीराधा शतक (2)
hindi_text: हे कीर्ति-कुमारी श्री राधा! आप परम कृपालु और उदार हैं; कृपा करके अपनी इस दासी पर दृष्टि कीजिए और मुझे अपने निज-महल की टहल प्रदान कीजिए।
english_text:
Shri Vrishbanu Kumari, Param Udar Kripal Tum.
Dasi Mohi Vichari, Tahal Mahal Ki Dijiye.
- Shri Lal Balbir Ji, Braj Binod, ShriRadha Shatak (2)

O, dear Radha, the most charming daughter of Kirti, You are the most gracious and extremely generous, please think about me and be merciful to accept me as a maidservant of your personal palace.
english_translation:
Shri Vrishbanu Kumari, Param Udar Kripal Tum.
Dasi Mohi Vichari, Tahal Mahal Ki Dijiye.
- Shri Lal Balbir Ji, Braj Binod, ShriRadha Shatak (2)

O, dear Radha, the most charming daughter of Kirti, You are the most gracious and extremely generous, please think about me and be merciful to accept me as a maidservant of your personal palace.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: राधा-चरण-रणन्मणिनूपुरमूकीकृतां हरेर्मुरलीम् - श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (9.30)
sanskrit_text:
राधा-चरण-रणन्मणिनूपुरमूकीकृतां हरेर्मुरलीम्।
विफलित-तत्तत्फुत्कृतिमखिलसखीसार्थहासिनीं स्मरत॥
- श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (9.30)
hindi_text: श्रीराधा के चरणकमलों के नूपुरों के शब्द से मुरली के मूक (शब्द रहित) हो जाने से जब श्रीहरि बार-बार फूँकने पर भी व्यर्थ-मनोरथ हो गये, तब समस्त सखी-मण्डली हँसने लगी-यह लीला तू स्मरण कर।
english_text:
Radha-Charan-Rananmaninupuramukikritaam Harermuraleem.
Viphalit-Tattatphut Kritimakhilasakhisarthahasineem Smarat
- Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (9.30)

Everyone please meditate on Lord Krsna's flute, which is now completely silenced by the tinkling jewel ankle-bells on Radha’s feet. All its hissing is now useless. Now it is simply an object of laughter for all of Radha’s friends.
english_translation:
Radha-Charan-Rananmaninupuramukikritaam Harermuraleem.
Viphalit-Tattatphut Kritimakhilasakhisarthahasineem Smarat
- Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (9.30)

Everyone please meditate on Lord Krsna's flute, which is now completely silenced by the tinkling jewel ankle-bells on Radha’s feet. All its hissing is now useless. Now it is simply an object of laughter for all of Radha’s friends.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: यशोभिः पूरिता आशा कृतं विश्वानुरंजनम् - श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (4.32)
sanskrit_text:
यशोभिः पूरिता आशा कृतं विश्वानुरंजनम्।
हा हन्त दिड् मात्रमपि नेक्षे वृन्दावनेशयोः॥
- श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (4.32)
hindi_text: अनेक यश-कीर्त्ति से दशों दिशाएं पूर्ण हो चुकीं, विश्व का अनुरंजन (प्रससन्न करना) भी कर दिया, किन्तु हाय! श्रीवृन्दावनाधीश (श्रीयुगल-किशोर) की ओर देख मात्र भी नहीं सका।
english_text:
Yashobhih Purita Asha Kritam Vishwanuranjanam.
Ha Hant Dig Matrmapi Nekshe Vrindavaneshayoh.
- Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (4.32)

All directions are filled with my glory! I have made the entire world happy. Alas! Alas! Yet I couldn’t even look towards Shri Radha Krishn who are the splendid couple of Vrindavan!
english_translation:
Yashobhih Purita Asha Kritam Vishwanuranjanam.
Ha Hant Dig Matrmapi Nekshe Vrindavaneshayoh.
- Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (4.32)

All directions are filled with my glory! I have made the entire world happy. Alas! Alas! Yet I couldn’t even look towards Shri Radha Krishn who are the splendid couple of Vrindavan!
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: आई तुमरे द्वार श्रीवृषभानु कुमारि जू - श्री लाल बलबीर जी, श्रीराधा शतक (1)
sanskrit_text:
आई तुमरे द्वार, श्रीवृषभानु कुमारि जू।
चेरी हौं सुकमार, चरन सरन मैं राखीये॥
- श्री लाल बलबीर जी, श्रीराधा शतक (1)
hindi_text: हे श्री राधे! मैं आपके द्वार आई हूँ; कृपा करके मुझे अपने चरण-कमलों की शरण में रखिए, क्योंकि मैं आपकी नित्य दासी हूँ।
english_text:
Aayi Tumare Dvar, ShriVrishbhanu Kumari Ju.
Cheri Haun Sukamar, Charan Saran Main Raakhiye.
- Shri Lal Balbir Ji, ShriRadha Shatak (1)

O Shri Radhe, I came to your door, please keep me under the refuge of your lotus feet as I am your eternal servitor.
english_translation:
Aayi Tumare Dvar, ShriVrishbhanu Kumari Ju.
Cheri Haun Sukamar, Charan Saran Main Raakhiye.
- Shri Lal Balbir Ji, ShriRadha Shatak (1)

O Shri Radhe, I came to your door, please keep me under the refuge of your lotus feet as I am your eternal servitor.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: यावद्राधापदनखमणि चन्द्रिका नाविरास्ते - श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (13.2)
sanskrit_text:
यावद्राधापदनखमणि चन्द्रिका नाविरास्ते तावद् वृन्दावनभुवि मुदं नैति चेतश्चकोरी।
यावद वृन्दावनभुवि भवेन्नापि निष्ठा गरिष्ठा तावत् राधाचरणकरुणा नैव तादृश्युदेति॥
- श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (13.2)
hindi_text: जब तक श्रीराधा के पद नख की चन्द्रिका श्रीवृन्दावन-भूमि पर आविर्भूत नहीं होती, तब तक चकोर रूपी चित्त को आनन्द नहीं प्राप्त होता, और जब तक श्रीवृन्दावन-भूमि में पूर्ण निष्ठा नहीं होती, तब तक श्रीराधा चरण की कृपा भी पूर्ण रीति से उदित नहीं हो पाती।
english_text:
Yaavadradhapadanakhamani Chandrika Naaviraaste Taavad Vrindavanbhuvi Mudan Naiti Chetashchakori.
Yaavad Vrindavanabhuvi Bhavennaapi Nishtha Garishtha Taavat Radhacharanakaruna Naiv Taadrishyudeti.
- Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (13.2)

As long as the moonlight of Sri Radha's jewel toenails does not shine, the cakori bird of my heart can't be happy in this land of Vrindavan. As long as there is no deep faith in the land of Vrindavan the mercy of Sri Radha's feet does not appear.
english_translation:
Yaavadradhapadanakhamani Chandrika Naaviraaste Taavad Vrindavanbhuvi Mudan Naiti Chetashchakori.
Yaavad Vrindavanabhuvi Bhavennaapi Nishtha Garishtha Taavat Radhacharanakaruna Naiv Taadrishyudeti.
- Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (13.2)

As long as the moonlight of Sri Radha's jewel toenails does not shine, the cakori bird of my heart can't be happy in this land of Vrindavan. As long as there is no deep faith in the land of Vrindavan the mercy of Sri Radha's feet does not appear.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: त्रैलोक्य मोहिनीभिर्नवतरुणीभिर्महाविदग्धाभिः - श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (9.11)
sanskrit_text:
त्रैलोक्य मोहिनीभिर्नवतरुणीभिर्महाविदग्धाभिः।
आराध्यां स्मर वृन्दाविपिने सर्वोज्ज्वलां राधाम्॥
- श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (9.11)
hindi_text: त्रिभुवन को मोहिन करने वाली महा विदग्धा एवं नवतरुणीवृन्दों की आराध्य सर्वोज्ज्वल श्रीराधाजी का श्रीवृन्दावन में स्मरण कर।
english_text:
Trailokya Mohinibhirnavatarunibhirmahavidagdhabhih.
Aradhyam Smar Vrindavipine Sarvojjvalaam Radham.
- Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (9.11)

Please meditate on Sri Radha, who is the most splendidly beautiful of all beautiful girls, and who is worshipped by the most intelligent and beautiful girls in the three worlds.
english_translation:
Trailokya Mohinibhirnavatarunibhirmahavidagdhabhih.
Aradhyam Smar Vrindavipine Sarvojjvalaam Radham.
- Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (9.11)

Please meditate on Sri Radha, who is the most splendidly beautiful of all beautiful girls, and who is worshipped by the most intelligent and beautiful girls in the three worlds.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: राधे तेरे प्रेम की कापै कहि आवे - श्रीभट्ट देवाचार्य, युगल शतक (29)
sanskrit_text:
(दोहा)
मन बच कर्म दुर्गम सदा, ताहि व चरण छुबात।
राधे तेरे प्रेम की, कहि आवत नहिं बात॥
hindi_text:
(पद)
(राग बिलावल, एकताल)
राधे तेरे प्रेम की कापै कहि आवे।
तेरीसी गोपाल सौं, तो पै बनि आवै॥ [1]
मन बच क्रम दुर्गम किशोर, ताहि चरण छुड़ावै।
'श्री भट्ट' मति वृष भानु जे, प्रताप जनाबे॥ [2]
- श्रीभट्ट देवाचार्य, युगल शतक (29)

(दोहा)
हे श्रीराधे! जिनका साक्षात् दर्शन मन, वाणी और कर्मों के द्वारा भी सम्भव नहीं है और जो सर्वथा अगम्य एवं दुर्लभ हैं, वही सबके प्रियतम पूर्ण पुरुषोत्तम भगवान श्रीकृष्ण तुम्हारे श्रीचरणों में अपना शीश नवाते हैं। हे राधे! तुम्हारे अलौकिक प्रेम की महिमा वास्तव में विलक्षण है, जिसका वर्णन करना शब्दों की सीमा से परे है।

(पद)
यहाँ श्री श्रीभट्ट देवाचार्य जी सखियों के माध्यम से परम प्रेमा श्री वृषभानुजा श्री राधा के परम प्रभाव का वृतान्त व्यक्त कर रहे है।
हे राधे, तेरे परम प्रेम प्रभाव को यथार्थतः कोई नहीं कह सकता। तुमने प्रियतम से मान ठान लिया है और प्रियतम गोपाल तुझको मनाने के लिए आये है। [1]
श्री गोपाल से ऐसा मान तुझसे ही बन सकता है क्योंकि मन वच कर्म से दुर्गम किशोर स्वयं लीला स्वरूप धारण करके तुम्हारे प्रेम भाव के अधीन होकर तेरे चरण छू रहे हैं अर्थात तेरी मनुहार कर रहे है। श्री राधे ! ऐसा प्रेमप्रताप तेरा ही हो सकता है। [2]
english_text:
(Doha)
Man Bach Karm Durgam Sada, Taahi Va Charan Chubaat.
Radhe Tere Prem Ki, Kahi Aavat Nahin Baat.

(Pada)
(Raag Bilaval, Ektaal)
Radhe Tere Prem Ki Kaapai Kahi Aave. [1]
Terisi Gopal Saun, To Pai Bani Aavai. [2]
Man Bach Kram Durgam Kishor, Taahi Charan Chhudaavai. [3]
Shri Bhatt Mati Vrish Bhanu Je, Prataap Janaabe. [4]
- ShriBhatt Devacharya, Yugal Shatak (29)

(Doha)
O Radhe! The supreme God, Lord Krishna, who is beyond the reach of mind, speech, and actions and is exceedingly difficult to attain, places His head at your lotus feet. Truly, Radhe, the nature of your love is unparalleled and beyond words.

(Pada)
Here in his verse Shri Bhata Devacharya explains the benedictory influence of Shri Radha.
O Radha, who can explain the benedictory influence and grace of your divine love. [1]
When you do 'maan' (annoyed) from Shri Krishn, He comes to appease you. [2]
Shri Bhata Devacharya says that this kind of maan Leela can only be performed by You because Kishor Shri Krishn who is the supreme personality of Godhead, is inaccessible to all from their minds, thoughts and Karmas, comes to please You because of the benedictory influence of Your divine love. He falls at your feet just because of your magnificence and Divine love. [3 & 4]
english_translation:
(Doha)
Man Bach Karm Durgam Sada, Taahi Va Charan Chubaat.
Radhe Tere Prem Ki, Kahi Aavat Nahin Baat.

(Pada)
(Raag Bilaval, Ektaal)
Radhe Tere Prem Ki Kaapai Kahi Aave. [1]
Terisi Gopal Saun, To Pai Bani Aavai. [2]
Man Bach Kram Durgam Kishor, Taahi Charan Chhudaavai. [3]
Shri Bhatt Mati Vrish Bhanu Je, Prataap Janaabe. [4]
- ShriBhatt Devacharya, Yugal Shatak (29)

He falls at your feet just because of your magnificence and Divine love. [3 & 4]

title: वृन्दावनमनुविन्दाम्यहमपि देहं - श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (3.53)
sanskrit_text:
वृन्दावनमनुविन्दाम्यहमपि देहं श्वशूकरादीनाम्।
न पुनः परत्र सच्चित् सुखमयमपि॥
- श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (3.53)
hindi_text: श्रीवृन्दावन के कूकर शूकरादि का शरीर भी मैं धारण करूँगा, किन्तु और जगह देवताओं के लिए भी दुर्लभ सच्चिदानन्दमय शरीर को मैं नहीं चाहता।
english_text:
Vrindavanamanuvindaamyahamapi Deham Shvashukaraadinaam.
Na Punah Paratra Sachchit Sukhamayamapi.
- Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (3.53)

I wish to stay in Vrindavan, even in the body of an animal like a dog or a pig. I shall not stay in any other place, even if I have a body, made of eternity knowledge and bliss, that even the demigods cannot attain.
english_translation:
Vrindavanamanuvindaamyahamapi Deham Shvashukaraadinaam.
Na Punah Paratra Sachchit Sukhamayamapi.
- Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (3.53)

I wish to stay in Vrindavan, even in the body of an animal like a dog or a pig. I shall not stay in any other place, even if I have a body, made of eternity knowledge and bliss, that even the demigods cannot attain.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: श्रीराधे राधे रटौं - श्री लाल बलबीर जी, वृन्दावन शतक (2)
sanskrit_text:
श्रीराधे राधे रटौं, राधे कौ उर ध्यान।
मम कुल देवी देवता, राधा रमण सुजान॥
- श्री लाल बलबीर जी, वृन्दावन शतक (2)
hindi_text: मैं अहर्निश ‘श्री राधे-राधे’ का जप करना चाहता हूँ और एकान्त में हृदय में श्री राधा के स्वरूप का ध्यान करना चाहता हूँ। मेरे लिए तो कुलदेवी और कुलदेवता केवल श्री राधा–कृष्ण ही हैं।
english_text:
ShriRadhe Radhe Rataun, Radhe Kau Ur Dhyan.
Mam Kul Devi Devta, Radha Raman Sujaan.
- Shri Lal Balbeer Ji, Vrindavan Shatak (2)

I wish to chant Shri Radhey Radhey unceasingly, I desire to remember the form of Shri Radha unceasingly. One and only Shri Radha Krishn is my worshipful deity.
english_translation:
ShriRadhe Radhe Rataun, Radhe Kau Ur Dhyan.
Mam Kul Devi Devta, Radha Raman Sujaan.
- Shri Lal Balbeer Ji, Vrindavan Shatak (2)

I wish to chant Shri Radhey Radhey unceasingly, I desire to remember the form of Shri Radha unceasingly. One and only Shri Radha Krishn is my worshipful deity.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: वरमिह वृन्दारण्ये सुवराकी मदनमोहनद्वारि - श्री प्रबोधानंद सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (2.67 )
sanskrit_text:
वरमिह वृन्दारण्ये सुवराकी मदनमोहनद्वारि।
अपि सरमापि रमाप्रियसख्यपि नान्यत्र नो रमापि स्याम्॥
- श्री प्रबोधानंद सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (2.67 )
hindi_text: इस श्रीवृन्दावन में श्री राधा मदमोहन के दरवाजे पर तुच्छ कुक्करी (कुतिया) होकर भले ही रहूँगा, तथापि और जगह लक्ष्मी की प्यारी सखी अथवा स्वयं लक्ष्मी बनकर भी रहने की इच्छा नहीं है।
english_text:
Varamih Vrindaranye Suvaraki Madanmohanadvaari.
Api Saramaapi Ramaapriyasakhyapi Naanyatr No Ramaapi Syam.
- Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (2.67)

I pray that I may become an insignificant dog who lives at the doorstep of Shri Radha Krishn in Vrindavan rather living in any other place, even as a dear friend of the goddess Laksmi, or even as a goddess myself.
english_translation:
Varamih Vrindaranye Suvaraki Madanmohanadvaari.
Api Saramaapi Ramaapriyasakhyapi Naanyatr No Ramaapi Syam.
- Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (2.67)

I pray that I may become an insignificant dog who lives at the doorstep of Shri Radha Krishn in Vrindavan rather living in any other place, even as a dear friend of the goddess Laksmi, or even as a goddess myself.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: गोरी मन भोरी अहो - श्री लाल बलबीर जी, वृन्दावन शतक (1)
sanskrit_text:
गोरी मन भोरी अहो, श्रीराधे सुख रास।
चरन कमल बंदन करौं, पुजवौ जन की आस॥
- श्री लाल बलबीर जी, वृन्दावन शतक (1)
hindi_text: हे गौरांगी श्री राधे! हे कोमल-हृदया, समस्त आनन्द की मूल स्वरूपिणी! मैं आपके चरण-कमलों को प्रणाम करता हूँ; कृपा कर मुझे अपनी निष्काम सेवा प्रदान कर मेरे चित्त की अभिलाषा को पूर्ण कीजिए।
english_text:
Gori Man Bhori Aho, ShriRadhe Sukh Raas.
Charan Kamal Bandan Karaun, Pujavau Jan Ki Aas.
- Shri Lal Balbir Ji, Vrindavan Shatak (1)

O Shri Radha, O Goddess who is fair-complexioned, tender-hearted, the abode of all joy, I offer my respectful obeisances to your lotus feet. Please fulfill my desire to selflessly serve you unceasingly.
english_translation:
Gori Man Bhori Aho, ShriRadhe Sukh Raas.
Charan Kamal Bandan Karaun, Pujavau Jan Ki Aas.
- Shri Lal Balbir Ji, Vrindavan Shatak (1)

O Shri Radha, O Goddess who is fair-complexioned, tender-hearted, the abode of all joy, I offer my respectful obeisances to your lotus feet. Please fulfill my desire to selflessly serve you unceasingly.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: त्यक्त्वा वृन्दावनमिदमहो चेद्बहिर्यासि - श्री प्रबोधानंद सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (1.67 )
sanskrit_text:
त्यक्त्वा वृन्दावनमिदमहो चेद्बहिर्यासि नूनंक्षिप्त्वा कल्पद्रुमवरवनं हन्त शाखोटमेषि।
हित्वा वृन्दावन-रसकथामन्यवार्ता-रुचिश्चेज्ज्ञातं क्षिप्त्वा परमममृतं भोक्तुमिच्छुः श्वविष्ठाम्॥
- श्री प्रबोधानंद सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (1.67 )
hindi_text: यदि इस वृन्दावन को त्याग कर तू अन्यत्र जाये, तो सचमुच तू कल्पवक्षों के श्रेष्ठ वन को छोड़ कर सिहोर के जंगल में जाता है। यदि वृन्दावन के रस की कथा को छोड़ कर और वार्ता तुम्हें अच्छी लगे, तब तू जान ले कि उत्तमोत्तम अमृत को त्याग कर कुत्ते की विष्ठा भोजन करने की तुम्हारी इच्छा होती है।
english_text:
Tyaktva Vrindavanamidamaho Chedbahiryaasi Noonankshiptva Kalpadrumavaravanam Hant Shaakhotameshi.
Hitva Vrindavan-Rasakathamanyavaarta-Ruchishchejgyaatam Kshiptva Paramamamritam Bhoktumichchhuh Shvavishthaam.
- Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (1.67)

If you leave Vrindavan, if you leave this forest of kalpa-vriksa (wish fulfilling) trees and go to another forest, if you stop talking about the nectar of Vrindavan and take pleasure in other talks, then, knowingly throwing away the sweetest nectar, you desire to eat dog-stool.
english_translation:
Tyaktva Vrindavanamidamaho Chedbahiryaasi Noonankshiptva Kalpadrumavaravanam Hant Shaakhotameshi.
Hitva Vrindavan-Rasakathamanyavaarta-Ruchishchejgyaatam Kshiptva Paramamamritam Bhoktumichchhuh Shvavishthaam.
- Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (1.67)

title: श्री राधा राधा रटौ, त्याग जगत की आस - श्री लाल बलबीर जी, ब्रज बिनोद, वृन्दावन शतक (10)
sanskrit_text:
श्री राधा राधा रटौ, त्याग जगत की आस।
ब्रज वीथिन विचरत रहौ, कर वृन्दावन वास॥ [1]
कर वृन्दावनन वास रसिकजन संगति कीजै।
प्रेम पंथ मन ढरौ त्याग विष अमृत पीजै॥ [2]
कहैं 'लाल बलबीर' होय आनन्द अगाधा।
निश्चै करिके चित्त कहौ श्रीराधा राधा॥ [3]
- श्री लाल बलबीर जी, ब्रज बिनोद, वृन्दावन शतक (10)
hindi_text:
हे मन, इस भौतिक संसार की सभी इच्छाओं को त्यागते हुए श्री राधा राधा का निरंतर जप करो। ब्रज की गलियों में विचरण करो और वृंदावन धाम में निवास करो। [1]


वृंदावन में निवास करो और रसिक भक्तों की संगति करो, प्रेम के मार्ग को पूरी निष्ठा से स्वीकार करो, और विष के समान संसारिक विषयों का त्याग करते हुए अमृत का पान करो। [2]


श्री लालबलबीर कहते हैं, "निश्चय करके श्री राधा नाम का अपने ह्रदय से विश्वासपूर्वक जप करो, और असीम आनंद प्राप्त करो।" [3]
english_text:
Shri Radha Radha Ratau, Tyaag Jagat Ki Aas.
Braj Vithin Vicharat Rahau, Kar Vrindavan Vaas. [1]
Kar Vrindavan Vaas Rasikjan Sangati Keejai.
Prem Panth Man Dharau Tyaag Vish Amrit Peejai. [2]
Kahain Laal Balbeer Hoy Aanand Agaadha.
Nishchai Karike Chitt Kahau Shriradha Radha. [3]
- Shri Laal Balbeer Ji, Braj Binod, Vrindavan Shatak (10)

O, mind, chant Śrī Rādhā Rādhā ceaselessly while giving up all the desires of this material world. Ramble around the lanes of Braj and reside in Vṛndāvana Dhām. [1]

Reside in Vṛndāvana and do the association of Rasik Devotees, accept the path of love wholeheartedly, and drink the nectar while giving up the sensual objects, which are like poison. [2]

Śrī Lal Balbir says, “Receive the boundless joy, simply chant Śrī Rādhā Rādhā faithfully from the bottom of your heart!” [3]
english_translation:

Braj Vithin Vicharat Rahau, Kar Vrindavan Vaas. [1]
